entry.heading: NACA
entry.body: NACA, , the predecessor of NASA, is founded.

entry.heading: National Aeronautics and Space Act
entry.body: U.S. President Dwight D. Eisenhower signs into law the National Aeronautics and Space Act, which creates the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).

entry.heading: Profect Mercury
entry.body: Project Mercury: NASA announces the selection of the United States' first seven astronauts, whom the news media quickly dub the 'Mercury Seven'.
